cl.x: Provide Sika® ViscoCrete®-5-500 where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02).
Sika® ViscoCrete®-5-500 is a third generation superplasticiser used to produce soft plastic concrete as well as state of the art, self compacting concrete (SCC) depending on the dose rate.

cl.t: Intended uses stated by the manufacturer
cl.l: Sika® ViscoCrete®-5-500 is ideal for the production of high performance concrete. It facilitates extremely high water reduction or highly flowable concrete for easy placement. Sika® ViscoCrete®-5-500 is used for the following types of concrete:
s: Precast concrete
Concrete requiring high water reduction
High strength concrete
Self compacting concrete (SCC)

cl.x: Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.5.

cl.c: Data sheet pages 1 and 2: Title block and supplier details
s: Product type as printed on the data sheet: HWR – High Range Water Reducer
Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48

cl.x: Sika® ViscoCrete®-5-500 meets and exceeds all requirements of Australian Standard 1478.1-2000 for High Range Water Reducing Admixture (HWR).

cl.l: When using Sika® ViscoCrete®-5-500, the following concrete properties are obtained :
s: High workability, flowability and finishability
Extremely high water reduction can be achieved, resulting in high early strength concrete.
Improved shrinkage and creep behaviour can be observed.
Excellent flow can also be achieved resulting in better placement and compaction of the concrete.
Suitable for the production of Self Compacting Concrete or super workable concrete.
Composition: Mixture of modified polycarboxylates
Appearance and colour: Clear brown liquid
Specific gravity: 1.07 g/cm³
Packaging: Bulk deliveries; 1000 litre IBC; 205 litre drum; 10 litre container
Shelf life: Stored at temperatures between 5°C and 35°C in unopened original containers, protected from direct sunlight and frost, shelf life is at least one (1) year.
Storage conditions: Store at temperature between 5°C and 35°C protected from the direct sunlight.

r: Sika® ViscoCrete®-5-500 can be used in conjunction with all the Sika Concrete Admixtures, except Sikament NN.

cl.c: Data sheet page 1: Product Information > Recommended dosage
cl.x: Typical dosage for soft concrete production is 300mls-600mls per 100kg of total cementitious material. For self compacting concrete, typical dosage is 700mls-1000mls per 100kg of total cementitious material.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Product Information > Dispensing
cl.x: Sika® ViscoCrete®-5-500 is added together with the batching water. For optimum utilisation of the high range water reduction we recommend thorough mixing at a minimum wet mixing time of 60 seconds per cubic metre after the admixture addition. Do not add to a dry mix.

s: When using Sika® ViscoCrete®-5-500 actual setting time will depend on site conditions. This should be checked and predetermined beforehand with trial mixes.
Special mix design is required to achieve Self Compacting Concrete (SCC).
May slightly increase air content of concrete at normal dose.
Do not mix with naphthalene based admixtures.
